bet_tested: The existing broad 060-920 blind packet can be re-scored against the expanded 060 terminal-cap paradigm: strict cap member 920, sibling cap 820, near-cap/internal-boundary member 692, and cap member 550.

060_920.interpretation: Strong visual support for 920 as a distinctive cap member after 060.

060_820.interpretation: Weak/inconsistent visual support. BC009/L-21 was the old low-confidence false positive and is now a predicted sibling-cap partial hit, but BC005/M-31 was missed.

060_692.interpretation: No visual support for a shared 920-like cap morphology. This is compatible with 692 being a functional near-cap/internal-boundary member, not a visual allograph of 920.

060_550.interpretation: No visual support from this packet.

decision: Promote functional terminal-cap paradigm only; demote shared visual shape-family interpretation. The blind packet independently supports 060-920 and gives one weak predicted hit for 060-820, but it does not make 692 or 550 visually cap-like.
model_update: Treat 060 as a structural hinge whose cap members need not be graphically similar. 920 is the visually distinctive member selected by 741/742/745; 820 is a portable closure sign shared with 002; 692 is a near-cap/internal-boundary member; 550 remains a structural cap with no visual promotion.
falsifiers: A new blind packet containing balanced 060-920, 060-820, 060-692, 060-550, and 060-noncap rows should not be scored as shared visual allography unless readers recover multiple cap members above controls.
If future readers consistently classify 692/550 as controls while only 920 is cap-like, the shared visual-family bet stays dead but the functional slot grammar can still survive.
